thread: maria: Heads up — CI docs build is failing on the docs-next branch. Linkcheck shows a bunch of missing anchors and MDX codeblocks rendering oddly. aj: Can you paste the CI error and a link to the PR? maria: CI log snippet: ``` LinkCheckError: Anchor not found: #runtime-config Error: MDX parse warning: Unexpected fenced code block inside heading at docs/guides/runtime.mdx:42 ``` maria: PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/814 (blocked by build) ryan: Looks like two separate problems: anchor slugs mismatching (slash and colon variants) and a weird codeblock/heading parse — probably unescaped backticks inside a heading or a code fence immediately after a heading. sam: For the anchors we can either add explicit html anchors or normalize the headings so remark-slug generates the intended id. I prefer not to change visible headings if we can avoid it. olivia: Quick workaround: add an explicit anchor before the heading: "" That should keep permalinks stable without renaming headings. aj: That solves the missing-anchor errors fast. For the MDX parse warning we should move the code fence one line down or add a blank line between heading and fenced block. CI is strict about that. ryan: I can run a small script to scan for headings with slashes/colon characters and either insert explicit anchors or normalize them to dashes. Proposed command: ``` node tools/regenerate-mdx-slugs.js --path docs/guides --mode insert-anchor ``` sam: If you go the script route, check Windows path handling — some of our sed/perl one-liners break on contributors' machines. Use a Node script to be safe. maria: Also we need to avoid touching permalinks that customers may have bookmarked. If we insert anchors we should include a comment like `` so it's obvious in the future. aj: I'll open a tiny PR with the explicit anchors + blank-line-before-codefix for the problematic files. Keeping it minimal to unblock CI. Assigning reviewers: @ryan and @olivia. ryan: I'll run the linkcheck locally after aj's patch and then re-run the full docs build on CI. If anything else pops up I’ll push a follow-up script. olivia: Thanks — can we also add a CI job that runs `mdx` parse in strict mode earlier? That would've caught the heading+codeblock issue before the linkcheck step. docs-bot: build status: docs-next (#814) — Failed — linkcheck errors (see CI) :warning: maria: Thanks — AJ, assign the PR to me too and I'll verify redirects stay intact before merging. :thumbsup: aj: PR posted: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/815 — tiny anchor inserts + blank-line fixes, tests added. ryan: LGTM once CI is green. I'll queue a rebuild in ~10m. maria: Great, thanks everyone. We'll keep an eye for post-merge redirects and run the redirect-checker job as a follow-up.
